⛴️ Tiny Ferry Balance

Ferry tilt0°
Deck load0 / 16
GoalLoad all 4 safely

Tap a car or crate, then tap a ferry slot. Heavy items near the edges tip the ferry more. Keep the tilt under 12° and load everything.

Select something on the dock.

Clean Crossing!

The ferry is balanced and ready to shove off.
